mode: Actual application functions, reviewer-owned Python-created software text inputs and inert DOM. Not browser layout or snippet-intent approval.

results.name: actual code, extracted source and historical output UI shows exact text and truthful distinct provenance
source text that resembles HTML is set as text, never evaluated or interpreted as markup
missing artifact disables rendered answers and direct keyboard/select/submit actions
whole selected exam scope is refused if any supplemental input is missing, without silent filtering
saved input stamp binds exact metadata and bytes, survives backup roundtrip and cannot silently adopt new reviewed text
active exam renders only approved given code/output, no lecture-source navigation, no worked answer
required legacy saved code exams without stamps remain blocked and deadline is preserved
paper and worked solutions include exact input text; paper never adds the computed answer key
native print and new print requests revoke previously rendered snippets when their local bytes or review change
